   129	def ss_episode_loss(feat, labels, K, alpha, tau):
   130	    if K < 2:
   131	        raise RuntimeError("single-support CVaR needs NUM_INSTANCE >= 2")
   132	    B, D = feat.shape
   133	    if B % K != 0:
   134	        raise RuntimeError(f"batch {B} not divisible by K={K}")
   135	    P = B // K
   136	    lab = labels.view(P, K)
   137	    if not torch.equal(lab, lab[:, :1].expand_as(lab)):
   138	        raise RuntimeError("batch not grouped as P contiguous ids × K instances")
   139	    z = F.normalize(feat, dim=1).contiguous().view(P, K, D)
   140	    risks = []
   141	    for s in range(K):
   142	        proto = z[:, s]
   143	        q_slots = [j for j in range(K) if j != s]
   144	        qz = z[:, q_slots].reshape(P, K - 1, D)
   145	        logits = torch.einsum("nqd,md->nqm", qz, proto) / tau
   146	        tgt = torch.arange(P, device=feat.device)[:, None].expand(P, K - 1)
   147	        ce = F.cross_entropy(logits.reshape(-1, P), tgt.reshape(-1), reduction="none").view(P, K - 1)
   148	        risks.append(ce.mean(1))
   149	    risks = torch.stack(risks, dim=1)            # [P,K]
   150	    ss_ce = risks.mean()
   151	    tail_k = max(1, int(math.ceil((1.0 - alpha) * K)))
   152	    ss_cvar = torch.topk(risks, tail_k, dim=1).values.mean()
   153	    return ss_ce, ss_cvar

   170	        if cfg.MODEL.POSE_ENABLED:
   171	            img, pid, camid, camids, viewid, _, pose_dict = batch
   172	            pose_dict = _pose_to_device(pose_dict, device)
   173	        else:
   174	            img, pid, camid, camids, viewid, _ = batch
   175	            pose_dict = None

   177	        feat = _extract_feat_flip(model, img, pose_dict, camids, viewid, cfg.MODEL.POSE_ENABLED, flip_test)
   178	        if isinstance(feat, dict):
   179	            raise RuntimeError("expected global tensor feat, got dict")
   180	        feats.append(feat.detach().cpu())
   181	        pids.extend(np.asarray(pid)); camids_all.extend(np.asarray(camid))
   182	    if old is not None:
   183	        m.pose_test_feat = old
   184	    feats = F.normalize(torch.cat(feats, 0).float(), dim=1).numpy()
   185	    pids = np.asarray(pids); camids_all = np.asarray(camids_all)

   188	
   189	
   190	def eval_fixed(qf, qp, qc, gf, gp, gc, g_idx, valid_q):
   191	    gff, gpp, gcc = gf[g_idx], gp[g_idx], gc[g_idx]
   192	    aps, r1s, false10 = [], [], []
   193	    for i in valid_q:
   194	        sim = qf[i] @ gff.T
   195	        keep = ~((gpp == qp[i]) & (gcc == qc[i]))
   196	        s, gpk = sim[keep], gpp[keep]
   197	        order = np.argsort(-s); match = (gpk[order] == qp[i])
   198	        if not match.any():
   199	            aps.append(0.0); r1s.append(0.0); false10.append(1.0); continue
   200	        cum = np.cumsum(match); ranks = np.arange(1, len(match) + 1)
   201	        aps.append((cum[match] / ranks[match]).mean()); r1s.append(float(match[0]))
   202	        false10.append(float((gpk[order[:10]] != qp[i]).mean()))
   203	    return 100 * np.mean(aps), 100 * np.mean(r1s), float(np.mean(false10))
   204	
   205	
   206	def single_support_diag(qf, qp, qc, gf, gp, gc, seeds=20):
   207	    id2g = defaultdict(list)
   208	    for i, p in enumerate(gp): id2g[int(p)].append(i)
   209	    q_ids = set(qp.tolist())
   210	    hasq = [p for p in id2g if p in q_ids]
   211	    distractor_g = np.asarray([i for p in id2g if p not in q_ids for i in id2g[p]], dtype=int)
   212	    valid_q = np.asarray([i for i in range(len(qf))
   213	                          if (gp[~((gp == qp[i]) & (gc == qc[i]))] == qp[i]).any()], dtype=int)
   214	
   215	    def supp_g(sidx):
   216	        chunks = [np.asarray(sidx, dtype=int)]
   217	        if len(distractor_g): chunks.append(distractor_g)
   218	        return np.concatenate(chunks)
   219	
   220	    full_mAP, full_R1, full_f10 = eval_fixed(qf, qp, qc, gf, gp, gc, np.arange(len(gf)), valid_q)
   221	    rand_mAPs = []
   222	    for sd in range(seeds):
   223	        rng = np.random.RandomState(sd)
   224	        rand_mAPs.append(eval_fixed(qf, qp, qc, gf, gp, gc, supp_g([rng.choice(id2g[p]) for p in hasq]), valid_q)[0])
   225	    best_s, worst_s = [], []
   226	    for p in hasq:
   227	        gi = id2g[p]; qs = np.where(qp == p)[0]
   228	        qual = [(qf[qs[qc[qs] != gc[g]]] @ gf[g]).mean() if (qc[qs] != gc[g]).any() else -1 for g in gi]
   229	        best_s.append(gi[int(np.argmax(qual))]); worst_s.append(gi[int(np.argmin(qual))])
   230	    best_mAP, _, best_f10 = eval_fixed(qf, qp, qc, gf, gp, gc, supp_g(best_s), valid_q)
   231	    worst_mAP, _, worst_f10 = eval_fixed(qf, qp, qc, gf, gp, gc, supp_g(worst_s), valid_q)
   232	    rng0 = np.random.RandomState(0)
   233	    rand_f10 = eval_fixed(qf, qp, qc, gf, gp, gc, supp_g([rng0.choice(id2g[p]) for p in hasq]), valid_q)[2]
   234	    print(f"  [DIAG] full={full_mAP:.2f}(R1 {full_R1:.2f} f10 {full_f10:.3f}) "
   235	          f"best={best_mAP:.2f}(f10 {best_f10:.3f}) "
   236	          f"random={np.mean(rand_mAPs):.2f}±{np.std(rand_mAPs):.2f}(f10 {rand_f10:.3f}) "
   237	          f"worst={worst_mAP:.2f}(f10 {worst_f10:.3f}) best-worst={best_mAP-worst_mAP:.2f}", flush=True)
   238	    return full_mAP, np.mean(rand_mAPs), worst_mAP
   239

   241	def main():
   242	    args = parse_args()
   243	    set_seed(1234)
   244	    cfg_setup(args)

     3	## cheap kill-switch（frozen SOLIDER Market exp260b, 零训练, 2026-06-28）
     4	
     5	### v1 → codex 审抓 3 High → v2 修
     6	
     7	| | full | best-support | random-support | worst-support | best-worst gap |
     8	|---|---|---|---|---|---|
     9	| v1（污染）| 94.43 | 98.61（>full!）| 96.46 | 88.17 | 10.44 |
    10	| **v2（干净）** | 94.43 | 76.08 | 73.36±0.22(20seed) | 63.82 | **12.27** |
    11	
    12	★v1 污染（codex 审抓）：single-support 跳无 positive query（比不同子集）+ distractor 压 1 张（负样本池变）→ best/random>full 假象。
    13	★v2 修（codex 3 High）：common-valid query 共用 + distractor 全量 + 20 seed + missing 记 0。**single-support 都 <full（合理少正样本），best-worst 12.27 + random-worst 9.54，false10 best0.923≈worst0.927 → gap 不被 #false-in-topk 解释**。
    14	
    15	### codex 两轮审（用户要审查交 codex）
    16	- v1：needs-attention，3 个 High（valid-query 污染 / 负样本池变 / kill-switch 不硬）。
    17	- v2：needs-attention（轻微残留非致命）：false10 没给 random mean/std + go 没检查 false10 + missing 可能混 camera-coverage。best/worst oracle 用 query-label 可接受。
    18	
    19	## ★VERDICT GO（基本可信）
    20	
    21	support 选择有 oracle headroom（best-worst 12.27，不被 #false 解释），单图 support representation 是真训练瓶颈。**诚实标注**：best/worst 用 query-label oracle 上下界，证 headroom 存在；训练能否学到（不用 query）要 Single-Support CVaR train 验。
    22

     9	## 核心假设
    10	
    11	ReID 训练用 multi-shot gallery（每 ID 多图），但模型学到的身份边界可能依赖"见过该 ID 多个 view"。部署常 single-shot（单图 support 定义新身份）。训练时**强制单图 support + CVaR worst-support 优化**，逼模型学"从任意单图恢复完整身份边界"的鲁棒表征，而非依赖 multi-view 平均。
    12	
    13	## cheap kill-switch（零训练，cvpb_single_support_probe.py）
    14	
    15	复用 Market 特征 cache（frozen SOLIDER exp260b）。每 gallery ID 只留 1 图：
    16	- full-gallery：上界
    17	- best-support：每 ID 选最好单图（同 ID query 平均 sim 最高，oracle 上界）
    18	- random-support：每 ID 随机 1 图
    19	- worst-support：每 ID 选最差单图（CVaR worst-case 目标针对的）
    20	
    21	**GO**（support 选择是真训练瓶颈）：worst 比 full 掉 > 3 mAP 且 **best−worst gap > 3 mAP**（哪张 support 图很重要 = support 选择 matters，值得 CVaR 优化）。
    22	**DEAD**：best≈worst（哪张 support 都一样，没 support 选择价值）或 single≈full（单图够）。
    23	
    24	★诚实设计要点：单图 vs 多图必掉 mAP（少正样本）是 trivial，所以**关键判据是 best−worst gap**（同样单图，选择重不重要），不是 single<full。codex 审 probe 验这个设计是否真有意义（用户要审查交 codex）。

    15	def _compute_maxsim_triplet(kp_feats, kp_weights, labels, margin=0.3, tau=0.05):
    16	    """Set-to-Set Metric Learning via Soft-MaxSim Triplet.
    17	
    18	    Replaces pooled-vector triplet with ColBERT-style late interaction triplet.
    19	    Each query keypoint soft-aligns to the best gallery keypoint via temperature softmax.
    20	
    21	    Args:
    22	        kp_feats: (B, K, D) keypoint features from GCN branch
    23	        kp_weights: (B, K) keypoint confidence scores
    24	        labels: (B,) identity labels
    25	        margin: triplet margin

    27	    Returns:
    28	        loss: scalar triplet loss
    29	        stats: dict with diagnostic metrics

   345	    def _load_persons(self, filename, img_h, img_w):
   346	        """Load per-person npz files and project heatmaps to full-image space.
   347	
   348	        Returns list of dicts with keys: heatmap (17,img_h,img_w), kp (17,2),
   349	        scores (17,), visibility (17,), visibility_binary (17,).
   350	        Target person is always placed at index 0.
   351	        """
   352	        entry = self.index.get(filename)
   353	        if entry is None:
   354	            return []
   355	
   356	        # Reorder persons so target is first
   357	        person_files = list(entry['persons'][:self.max_persons])
   358	        target_idx = entry.get('target_person_idx', 0)
   359	        if 0 < target_idx < len(person_files):
   360	            # Move target to front, keep others in original order
   361	            target_file = person_files.pop(target_idx)
   362	            person_files.insert(0, target_file)
   363	
   364	        persons = []
   365	        for npz_name in person_files:
   366	            # Support both relative (normal) and absolute (merged val) paths
   367	            if os.path.isabs(npz_name):
   368	                npz_path = npz_name
   369	            else:
   370	                npz_path = os.path.join(self.pose_dir, npz_name)
   371	            if not os.path.exists(npz_path):
   372	                continue
   373	            with np.load(npz_path) as data:
   374	                hm_raw = torch.from_numpy(
   375	                    data['heatmap'].astype(np.float32))   # (17, 64, 48)
   376	                kp = data['keypoints'].astype(np.float32)  # (17, 2) image pixels
   377	                scores = data['scores'].astype(np.float32)  # (17,)
   378	                crop_bounds = data['crop_bounds'].astype(np.float32)  # (4,)
   379	                if 'visibility' in data.files:
   380	                    visibility = data['visibility'].astype(np.float32)
   381	                else:
   382	                    # Backward compatibility for legacy pose_data without
   383	                    # explicit visibility extraction.
   384	                    visibility = np.clip(scores, 0.0, 1.0).astype(np.float32)
   385	                if 'visibility_binary' in data.files:
   386	                    visibility_binary = data['visibility_binary'].astype(
   387	                        np.float32)
   388	                else:

   391	            # Project bbox-local heatmap onto full-image canvas

   405	    def _place_heatmap(heatmap, crop_bounds, img_h, img_w):
   406	        """Resize heatmap to crop_bounds region and place on full-image canvas.
   407	
   408	        Args:
   409	            heatmap: (17, hm_h, hm_w) in crop-local space

   411	                         (may extend beyond image bounds)

   436	        dst_y2 = min(img_h, int(round(cy2)))
   437	
   438	        if dst_x2 <= dst_x1 or dst_y2 <= dst_y1:
   439	            return torch.zeros(17, img_h, img_w)
   440	
   441	        # Clamp copy size to actual available data on both sides
   442	        copy_w = min(dst_x2 - dst_x1, crop_w_int - src_x1)
   443	        copy_h = min(dst_y2 - dst_y1, crop_h_int - src_y1)
   444	        if copy_w <= 0 or copy_h <= 0:
   445	            return torch.zeros(17, img_h, img_w)
   446	
   447	        canvas = torch.zeros(17, img_h, img_w)
   448	        canvas[:, dst_y1:dst_y1 + copy_h, dst_x1:dst_x1 + copy_w] = \
   449	            hm_resized[:, src_y1:src_y1 + copy_h, src_x1:src_x1 + copy_w]
   450	        return canvas

   453	    #  Joint augmentations

   456	    @staticmethod
   457	    def _joint_resize(img, persons, orig_h, orig_w, target_h, target_w):
   458	        """Resize image and all pose data to (target_h, target_w)."""
   459	        img = img.resize((target_w, target_h), Image.BICUBIC)
   460	
   461	        sx = target_w / orig_w
   462	        sy = target_h / orig_h
   463	
   464	        for p in persons:
   465	            p['heatmap'] = F.interpolate(
   466	                p['heatmap'].unsqueeze(0), size=(target_h, target_w),
   467	                mode='bilinear', align_corners=False).squeeze(0)
   468	            p['kp'][:, 0] *= sx
   469	            p['kp'][:, 1] *= sy
   470	
   471	        return img, persons
   472	
   473	    @staticmethod
   474	    def _joint_flip(img, persons, width):
   475	        """Horizontal flip image + heatmaps + keypoints."""
   476	        img = img.transpose(Image.FLIP_LEFT_RIGHT)
   477	
   478	        for p in persons:
   479	            # Flip heatmap spatially
   480	            p['heatmap'] = p['heatmap'].flip(-1)
   481	            # Swap left-right channels
   482	            for l, r in FLIP_PAIRS:
   483	                p['heatmap'][[l, r]] = p['heatmap'][[r, l]]
   484	
   485	            # Mirror x coordinates
   486	            p['kp'][:, 0] = width - 1 - p['kp'][:, 0]
   487	            # Swap left-right keypoints
   488	            for l, r in FLIP_PAIRS:
   489	                p['kp'][[l, r]] = p['kp'][[r, l]]
   490	                p['scores'][[l, r]] = p['scores'][[r, l]]
   491	                p['visibility'][[l, r]] = p['visibility'][[r, l]]
   492	                p['visibility_binary'][[l, r]] = p['visibility_binary'][[r, l]]
   493	
   494	        return img, persons
   495	
   496	    @staticmethod
   497	    def _joint_pad_crop(img, persons, target_h, target_w, pad):
   498	        """Pad image+heatmaps with zeros, then random crop back to target size.
   499	
   500	        Returns: (cropped_img, persons, crop_x, crop_y)
   501	        """
   502	        # Pad image
   503	        padded = Image.new(img.mode,
   504	                           (target_w + 2 * pad, target_h + 2 * pad),
   505	                           (0, 0, 0))
   506	        padded.paste(img, (pad, pad))
   507	
   508	        # Random crop offsets
   509	        crop_x = random.randint(0, 2 * pad)
   510	        crop_y = random.randint(0, 2 * pad)
   511	        img_cropped = padded.crop((crop_x, crop_y,
   512	                                   crop_x + target_w, crop_y + target_h))
   513	
   514	        for p in persons:
   515	            # Pad heatmap
   516	            p['heatmap'] = F.pad(p['heatmap'],
   517	                                 (pad, pad, pad, pad), value=0)
   518	            # Crop heatmap with same offsets
   519	            p['heatmap'] = p['heatmap'][:,
   520	                                        crop_y:crop_y + target_h,
   521	                                        crop_x:crop_x + target_w]
   522	
   523	            # Offset keypoints: pad shifts, then crop shifts back
   524	            p['kp'][:, 0] += pad - crop_x
   525	            p['kp'][:, 1] += pad - crop_y
   526	
   527	            # Mark out-of-bounds keypoints
   528	            oob = ((p['kp'][:, 0] < 0) | (p['kp'][:, 0] >= target_w) |
   529	                   (p['kp'][:, 1] < 0) | (p['kp'][:, 1] >= target_h))
   530	            p['scores'][oob] = 0.0
   531	            p['visibility'][oob] = 0.0
   532	            p['visibility_binary'][oob] = 0.0
   533	            p['kp'][:, 0] = np.clip(p['kp'][:, 0], 0, target_w - 1)
   534	            p['kp'][:, 1] = np.clip(p['kp'][:, 1], 0, target_h - 1)
   535	
   536	        return img_cropped, persons, crop_x, crop_y
   537	
   538	    def _image_to_tensor(self, img):
   539	        """PIL Image -> normalized float tensor (3, H, W)."""

   541	        tensor = torch.from_numpy(arr.transpose(2, 0, 1))  # (3, H, W)
   542	        return (tensor - self.pixel_mean) / self.pixel_std

   544	    def _make_pcvt_views(self, base_tensor, persons):

   559	            view_b, _ = self._random_erase(base_tensor.clone())
   560	            meta = {
   561	                'pcvt_cov_a': torch.tensor(0.0, dtype=torch.float32),
   562	                'pcvt_cov_b': torch.tensor(0.0, dtype=torch.float32),
   563	                'pcvt_cov_u': torch.tensor(0.0, dtype=torch.float32),
   564	                'pcvt_ovr': torch.tensor(0.0, dtype=torch.float32),
   565	                'pcvt_mga': torch.tensor(0.0, dtype=torch.float32),
   566	                'pcvt_mgb': torch.tensor(0.0, dtype=torch.float32),
   567	                'pcvt_gca': torch.tensor(0.0, dtype=torch.float32),
   568	                'pcvt_gcb': torch.tensor(0.0, dtype=torch.float32),
   569	                'pcvt_fb': torch.tensor(1.0, dtype=torch.float32),
   570	            }
   571	            return view_a, view_b, meta
   572	
   573	        hm = persons[0]['heatmap']  # (17, H, W)
   574	        visible_parts = []

   576	            part_hm = hm[kp_indices]

   616	        owner = part_stack.argmax(dim=0)

    11	
    12	    batchsize = features.size(0)
    13	    dim = features.size(-1)
    14	    # Shift Operation
    15	    feature_random = torch.cat([features[:, begin-1+shift:], features[:, begin:begin-1+shift]], dim=1)

    23

    25	    x = x.view(batchsize, -1, dim)
    26

  1071	def _collate_pose_dicts(pose_dicts):
  1072	    """Stack a list of pose_dict into batched tensors."""
  1073	    batched = {}
  1074	    for key in pose_dicts[0]:
  1075	        if key == 'num_persons':
  1076	            batched[key] = torch.tensor(
  1077	                [d[key] for d in pose_dicts], dtype=torch.int64)
  1078	        elif isinstance(pose_dicts[0][key], dict):
  1079	            # Nested dict (e.g. teacher_pose): collate recursively
  1080	            nested = [d[key] for d in pose_dicts if key in d]
  1081	            if nested:
  1082	                batched[key] = _collate_pose_dicts(nested)
  1083	        else:
  1084	            batched[key] = torch.stack(
  1085	                [d[key] for d in pose_dicts], dim=0)
  1086	    return batched

  1089	def pose_train_collate_fn(batch):

  1100	                for v in range(n_views)]

     1	"""Pose-guided ReID model with backbone-internal pose injection.
     2	
     3	Instead of post-hoc part pooling, injects pose information directly into
     4	the backbone's feature extraction process via Pose Spatial Gates (PSG)
     5	applied between Stage 3 blocks.
     6	
     7	This changes HOW features are formed, not just how they're pooled.
     8	"""

    11	import torch.nn.functional as F

    24	class PoseBackboneModel(build_transformer):

    28	    - Swin backbone Stages 0-2: unchanged

    30	    - Global feature (GAP -> BN -> classifier)
    31	    - Optional: Skeleton GCN part branch, PAA adapter, LTCS/LPCS heads
    32	
    33	    Test feature = global feature (pose-aware).
    34	    """

    38	
    39	        # Determine which stages get pose injection
    40	        psg_stages = list(getattr(cfg.MODEL, 'POSE_PSG_STAGES', [-1]))
    41	        num_backbone_stages = len(self.base.stages)
    42	        # Resolve negative indices
    43	        self.psg_stage_indices = set()
    44	        for s in psg_stages:
    45	            idx = s if s >= 0 else num_backbone_stages + s
    46	            self.psg_stage_indices.add(idx)
    47	
    48	        hidden_dim = getattr(cfg.MODEL, 'POSE_PFM_HIDDEN', 64)
    49	        spatial_conv = getattr(cfg.MODEL, 'POSE_PSG_SPATIAL', False)
    50	
    51	        # PSG-only mode: create gate modules per stage
    52	        self.psg_modules_dict = nn.ModuleDict()
    53	        for stage_idx in sorted(self.psg_stage_indices):
    54	            stage = self.base.stages[stage_idx]
    55	            feat_ch = self.base.num_features[stage_idx]
    56	            for block_idx in range(len(stage.blocks)):
    57	                key = f's{stage_idx}_b{block_idx}'
    58	                self.psg_modules_dict[key] = PoseSpatialGate(

    60	                    feat_channels=feat_ch,
    61	                    hidden_dim=hidden_dim,
    62	                    spatial_conv=spatial_conv,
    63	                )

    65	        # Backward compatibility: also keep psg_modules list for Stage 3

   144	                  'pose modules (PSG/LGPA/VCSR/PPA/STR/FSDC/...) will receive '
   145	                  'person-0 (target) heatmap instead of max-merged scene heatmap.')

   149	        if self._part_grad_scale > 0:

   196	            if self._lgpa_no_pose:
   197	                print('[LGPA] NO-POSE ablation: heatmaps=None -> no pose-bias/assign/visibility (pure CLIP-text parts)')
   198	            if self._lgpa_fixed_bands:

   206	                    self.clip_part_head.num_labels, self.clip_part_head.clip_dim,

   705	    def forward(self, x, label=None, cam_label=None, view_label=None,
   706	                pose_dict=None):

   708	        scene_heatmaps = None
   709	        target_heatmaps = None
   710	        if pose_dict is not None:
   711	            scene_heatmaps, _, target_heatmaps, _ = self._prepare_pose(pose_dict)
   712	            # exp357 pose-shuffle kill-switch: training-only cross-image permutation of the pose
   713	            # within the batch (each image gets ANOTHER image's real pose). Tests whether the
   714	            # CORRECT pose spatial content is causal for the LGPA gain. Test path uses true pose.
   715	            if self.training and getattr(self, 'use_pose_shuffle', False) and scene_heatmaps is not None:
   716	                Bp = scene_heatmaps.shape[0]
   717	                if Bp > 1:
   718	                    # derangement: NO image keeps its own pose (Codex: randperm leaves ~1 fixed point)
   719	                    ar = torch.arange(Bp, device=scene_heatmaps.device)
   720	                    perm = torch.randperm(Bp, device=ar.device)
   721	                    tries = 0
   722	                    while bool((perm == ar).any()) and tries < 8:
   723	                        perm = torch.randperm(Bp, device=ar.device); tries += 1
   724	                    if bool((perm == ar).any()):
   725	                        perm = torch.roll(ar, 1, 0)     # guaranteed-derangement fallback (cyclic shift)
   726	                    scene_heatmaps = scene_heatmaps[perm]

   728	                        target_heatmaps = target_heatmaps[perm]
   729	            # exp358 cross-PART (channel) shuffle: per-image permutation of the K keypoint
   730	            # channels — destroys anatomical part identity while keeping each image's own spatial
   731	            # support. Complements exp357 (cross-image): together they isolate whether the LGPA
   732	            # gain needs correct pose-image correspondence and/or correct anatomical part assignment.
   733	            if self.training and getattr(self, 'use_pose_channel_shuffle', False) and scene_heatmaps is not None:
   734	                Kc = scene_heatmaps.shape[1]
   735	                cperm = torch.argsort(torch.rand(scene_heatmaps.shape[0], Kc, device=scene_heatmaps.device), dim=1)
   736	                idx = cperm[:, :, None, None].expand(-1, -1, scene_heatmaps.shape[2], scene_heatmaps.shape[3])
   737	                scene_heatmaps = torch.gather(scene_heatmaps, 1, idx)

   744	        # target-person (index 0) signal instead of max-merged scene.

   753	                                    device=scene_heatmaps.device) >= self.pose_dropout_p)

   758

   768	            else:

   770	
   771	            # CLIP-ReID ID-prompt contrastive (the WORKING CLIP mechanism): align global feat
   772	            # to per-ID learnable text prototypes via SupCon i2t/t2i.
   773	            clip_id_loss = None
   774	            if getattr(self, 'use_clip_id_prompt', False) and label is not None:
   775	                from .modules.clip_id_prompt import supcon_i2t
   776	                # Option B: per-image pose conditions the prompt (pose_vec None unless pose_cond)
   777	                pose_vec = scene_heatmaps.float().mean(dim=(2, 3)) \
   778	                    if (getattr(self.clip_id_prompt, 'pose_cond', False) and scene_heatmaps is not None) else None
   779	                txt_proto = self.clip_id_prompt(label, pose_vec)  # (B, clip_dim)

   782	                    # Option C: K pose-localized part features, each aligned to the ID prototype
   783	                    part_feats = self.pose_guided_part_pool(featmaps[-1], scene_heatmaps)  # (B, nP, C)
   784	                    clip_id_loss = 0.0
   785	                    for kp in range(part_feats.shape[1]):
   786	                        ipk = self.clip_id_proj(part_feats[:, kp])
   787	                        clip_id_loss = clip_id_loss + supcon_i2t(ipk, txt_proto, label, t) \
   788	                            + supcon_i2t(txt_proto, ipk, label, t)

   790	                else:

   793	                        feat_for_clip = self.pose_weighted_pool(featmaps[-1], scene_heatmaps)
   794	                    elif getattr(self, 'use_clip_id_pose_guided', False) and scene_heatmaps is not None:
   795	                        feat_for_clip = self.pose_guided_pool(featmaps[-1], scene_heatmaps)
   796	                    else:
   797	                        feat_for_clip = global_feat
   798	                    img_proj = self.clip_id_proj(feat_for_clip)   # (B, clip_dim)
   799	                    clip_id_loss = supcon_i2t(img_proj, txt_proto, label, t) \
   800	                        + supcon_i2t(txt_proto, img_proj, label, t)

   802	                    # soft distribution over the batch's other-ID prototypes to this student.
   803	                    if getattr(self, 'use_pgpd', False) and scene_heatmaps is not None:
   804	                        clip_id_loss = clip_id_loss + self._pgpd_loss(img_proj, txt_proto, label, scene_heatmaps, target_heatmaps)

   810	                        tp = torch.nn.functional.normalize(txt_proto, dim=1)
   811	                        repel = (occ_proj * tp).sum(1).clamp(min=0).mean()

   818

   823	                    vcsr_input, scene_heatmaps, return_cls=True)

   826	
   827	            # Part branch: STD-PR (structural tokens) only — when GCN is NOT also enabled
   828	            elif getattr(self, 'use_structural_routing', False) and scene_heatmaps is not None \
   829	                    and not self.use_skeleton_gcn:
   830	                feat_map_detached = featmaps[-1].detach()
   831	                B_fm, C_fm, H_fm, W_fm = feat_map_detached.shape
   832	                spatial_tokens = feat_map_detached.flatten(2).transpose(1, 2)  # (B, H*W, C)
   833	                # Pass keypoints for anchor-sampled query initialization
   834	                kp_p0 = pose_dict['keypoints'][:, 0] if pose_dict is not None else None
   835	                sc_p0 = pose_dict['scores'][:, 0] if pose_dict is not None else None
   836	                router_out = self.structural_router(
   837	                    spatial_tokens, (H_fm, W_fm), scene_heatmaps,
   838	                    keypoints=kp_p0, scores=sc_p0,
   839	                    input_size=tuple(x.shape[2:]))
   840	                # Unpack: with self-attn returns (refined, stats, raw), without returns (tokens, stats)
   841	                if getattr(self, 'str_self_attn', False):
   842	                    structural_tokens, str_stats, raw_tokens = router_out
   843	                else:
   844	                    structural_tokens, str_stats = router_out
   845	                    raw_tokens = structural_tokens
   846	                # PLTD: Part-Level Token Dropout — randomly zero out tokens during training
   847	                part_drop_p = getattr(self, 'str_part_drop', 0.0)
   848	                if self.training and part_drop_p > 0:
   849	                    B_tok, K_tok, C_tok = structural_tokens.shape
   850	                    # Each token independently dropped with probability p
   851	                    # Ensure at least 2 tokens survive per sample
   852	                    drop_mask = torch.rand(B_tok, K_tok, 1, device=structural_tokens.device) >= part_drop_p
   853	                    # Guarantee minimum 2 tokens survive
   854	                    alive = drop_mask.squeeze(-1).sum(dim=1)  # (B,)
   855	                    for b_idx in range(B_tok):
   856	                        if alive[b_idx] < 2:
   857	                            # Randomly revive tokens until we have 2
   858	                            dead = (~drop_mask[b_idx].squeeze(-1)).nonzero(as_tuple=True)[0]
   859	                            revive = dead[torch.randperm(len(dead))[:2 - int(alive[b_idx].item())]]
   860	                            drop_mask[b_idx, revive] = True
   861	                    structural_tokens = structural_tokens * drop_mask.float()
   862	                    raw_tokens = raw_tokens * drop_mask.float()
   863	                    n_dropped = (1 - drop_mask.float()).sum() / (B_tok * K_tok)
   864	                    str_stats['pltd_drop'] = n_dropped.item()
   865	                # Part feature: confidence-weighted pooling from heatmap response
   866	                K_str = structural_tokens.shape[1]
   867	                if K_str == 6:
   868	                    # 6-part groups: compute per-part heatmap visibility
   869	                    _pg = [[0,1,2,3,4],[5,6,11,12],[5,7,9],[6,8,10],[11,13,15],[12,14,16]]
   870	                    hm_r = F.interpolate(scene_heatmaps, size=(H_fm, W_fm),
   871	                                        mode='bilinear', align_corners=False)
   872	                    pw = []
   873	                    for g in _pg:
   874	                        pw.append(hm_r[:, g].mean(dim=(1,2,3)))  # (B,)
   875	                    part_w = torch.stack(pw, dim=1)  # (B, 6)
   876	                    part_w = part_w / part_w.sum(dim=1, keepdim=True).clamp(min=1e-8)
   877	                    str_feat = (structural_tokens * part_w.unsqueeze(2)).sum(dim=1)
   878	                else:
   879	                    str_feat = structural_tokens.mean(dim=1)  # fallback
   880	                # Per-token or pooled classification

   882	                    # DPTL dual-path: CE on raw tokens (diversity), triplet on refined tokens (coherence)
   883	                    str_cls_list = []
   884	                    str_feat_list = []

   886	                    ce_tokens = raw_tokens
   887	                    # Triplet/test path uses refined tokens (contextualized)
   888	                    tri_tokens = structural_tokens

   893	                        str_feat_list.append(tri_tokens[:, k])  # refined for triplet

   900	                    str_feat_bn = self.structural_router.part_bn(str_feat)
   901	                    str_cls = self.str_classifier(str_feat_bn)
   902	                    kp_data = {'str_stats': str_stats}
   903	                    return [cls_score, str_cls], [global_feat, str_feat], featmaps, None, kp_data
   904	
   905	            elif getattr(self, 'use_lgpa', False) and (scene_heatmaps is not None or getattr(self, '_lgpa_fixed_bands', False)):
   906	                # LGPA: CLIP cross-attention part assignment
   907	                lgpa_input = featmaps[-1].detach() if getattr(self, '_lgpa_detach', False) else featmaps[-1]

   909	                lgpa_cls_scores, lgpa_feats, lgpa_data = self.clip_part_head(
   910	                    lgpa_input, lgpa_hm, return_cls=True)

   915	                # LGPA + GCN dual branch: also run GCN on detached features

   920	                        feat_map_detached, pose_dict, return_cls=True, label=label,
   921	                        stage2_feat=_s2_feat)

   925	                        if 'vcn_stats' in gcn_data:
   926	                            kp_data['vcn_stats'] = gcn_data['vcn_stats']

   928	                            [global_feat] + lgpa_feats + gcn_feats,
   929	                            featmaps, None, kp_data)
   930	
   931	                return [cls_score] + lgpa_cls_scores, [global_feat] + lgpa_feats, featmaps, None, kp_data
   932	
   933	            elif getattr(self, 'use_ppa', False) and scene_heatmaps is not None:

   937	                kp_data = ppa_data

   940	                if self.use_skeleton_gcn and pose_dict is not None:
   941	                    feat_map_detached = featmaps[-1].detach()
   942	                    _s2_feat = featmaps[-2].detach() if len(featmaps) >= 2 else None
   943	                    gcn_cls_scores, gcn_feats, gcn_data = self.skeleton_head(
   944	                        feat_map_detached, pose_dict, return_cls=True, label=label,
   945	                        stage2_feat=_s2_feat)
   946	                    # Merge: PPA kp_data takes priority, add GCN kp_feats for MaxSim
   947	                    if gcn_data and 'kp_feats' in gcn_data:

   949	                        kp_data['gcn_kp_weights'] = gcn_data['kp_weights']
   950	                    return ([cls_score] + ppa_cls_scores + gcn_cls_scores,
   951	                            [global_feat] + ppa_feats + gcn_feats,
   952	                            featmaps, None, kp_data)
   953	
   954	                return [cls_score] + ppa_cls_scores, [global_feat] + ppa_feats, featmaps, None, kp_data
   955	
   956	            elif self.use_skeleton_gcn and pose_dict is not None:
   957	                # GSPB: Gradient-scaled part branch

   457	    def _run_backbone_with_psg(self, x, scene_heatmaps, pose_dict=None):
   458	        """Run backbone forward with PSG injection in configured stages.
   459	
   460	        Manually iterates backbone stages, inserting PSG after each block
   461	        in the configured stages.
   462	        """
   463	        # Patch embedding
   464	        x, hw_shape = self.base.patch_embed(x)
   465	
   466	        # PAPE: add pose patch embedding (early pose injection)
   467	        if getattr(self, 'use_pose_patch_embed', False) and scene_heatmaps is not None:
   468	            H_hw, W_hw = hw_shape
   469	            # Resize heatmaps to match post-PatchEmbed spatial dims
   470	            hm = F.interpolate(scene_heatmaps, size=(H_hw, W_hw),
   471	                               mode='bilinear', align_corners=False)
   472	            pose_tokens = self.pose_patch_embed(hm)  # (B, C, H, W)
   473	            pose_tokens = pose_tokens.flatten(2).transpose(1, 2)  # (B, N, C)
   474	            x = x + pose_tokens.to(x.dtype)  # AMP safety
   475	
   476	        # Pose Prompt: KPR-style argmax part ID → learnable embedding → additive
   477	        if getattr(self, 'use_pose_prompt', False) and scene_heatmaps is not None:
   478	            H_hw, W_hw = hw_shape
   479	            # Resize 17-channel heatmaps to patch resolution
   480	            hm = F.interpolate(scene_heatmaps, size=(H_hw, W_hw),
   481	                               mode='bilinear', align_corners=False)  # (B, 17, H, W)
   482	            # Heatmaps are already [0,1] (ViTPose MSE-trained output, not logits)
   483	            # Only clamp float16 rounding artifacts (tiny negatives)
   484	            hm = hm.clamp(min=0)
   485	            # Background channel: 1 - max keypoint confidence
   486	            bg = 1.0 - hm.max(dim=1, keepdim=True)[0]  # (B, 1, H, W)
   487	            hm_with_bg = torch.cat([bg, hm], dim=1)  # (B, 18, H, W)
   488	            # Argmax → part ID per patch (detach: no gradient through heatmaps)
   489	            part_ids = hm_with_bg.detach().argmax(dim=1)  # (B, H, W) values in [0, 17]
   490	            part_ids = part_ids.reshape(part_ids.shape[0], -1)  # (B, N)
   491	            # Stochastic prompt drop during training (use empty prompt = all background)
   492	            if self.training and self.pose_prompt_drop > 0:
   493	                drop_mask = torch.rand(part_ids.shape[0], 1, device=part_ids.device) < self.pose_prompt_drop
   494	                part_ids = torch.where(drop_mask.expand_as(part_ids),
   495	                                       torch.zeros_like(part_ids), part_ids)  # 0 = background
   496	            # Lookup learnable embeddings, scale, and add to patch tokens
   497	            prompt_embeds = self.pose_prompt_embed(part_ids)  # (B, N, C)
   498	            prompt_embeds = prompt_embeds.to(x.dtype)  # AMP safety: match float16/32
   499	            scale = torch.sigmoid(self.pose_prompt_scale)  # learnable injection strength
   500	            x = x + scale * prompt_embeds
   501	
   502	        if self.base.use_abs_pos_embed:
   503	            x = x + self.base.absolute_pos_embed
   504	        x = self.base.drop_after_pos(x)
   505	
   506	        # Build semantic weight tensor
   507	        sw_val = self._semantic_weight_val
   508	        if self.base.semantic_weight >= 0:
   509	            w = torch.ones(x.shape[0], 1, device=x.device) * sw_val
   510	            w = torch.cat([w, 1 - w], dim=-1)
   511	            sem_weight = w
   512	        else:
   513	            sem_weight = None
   514	
   515	        outs = []
   516	        for i, stage in enumerate(self.base.stages):
   517	            if i in self.psg_stage_indices:
   518	                # Stage with PSG: manually run blocks with injection
   519	                x, hw_shape, out, out_hw_shape = self._run_stage_with_psg(
   520	                    stage, x, hw_shape, scene_heatmaps, stage_idx=i)

   548	    def _run_stage_with_psg(self, stage, x, hw_shape, scene_heatmaps,
   549	                            stage_idx=None):
   550	        """Run a stage's blocks with PSG and optional PAA injection."""
   551	        for block_idx, block in enumerate(stage.blocks):
   552	            key = f's{stage_idx}_b{block_idx}'
   553	
   554	            # Run the Swin block
   555	            x = block(x, hw_shape)
   556	
   557	            # PSG: apply gate after block
   558	            if scene_heatmaps is not None and key in self.psg_modules_dict:
   559	                x = self.psg_modules_dict[key](x, hw_shape, scene_heatmaps)
   560	
   561	            # PAA: apply additive adapter after PSG
   562	            if getattr(self, 'use_paa', False) and scene_heatmaps is not None and key in getattr(self, 'paa_modules_dict', {}):
   563	                x = self.paa_modules_dict[key](x, hw_shape, scene_heatmaps)
   564	
   565	        # Handle downsample (Stage 3 has no downsample in Swin)
   566	        if stage.downsample:
   567	            x_down, down_hw_shape = stage.downsample(x, hw_shape)
   568	            return x_down, down_hw_shape, x, hw_shape
   569	        else:
   570	            return x, hw_shape, x, hw_shape

   572	    def _canonical_heatmap(self, B, device):
   573	        """Fixed canonical upright-pedestrian COCO-17 pose heatmap (NO per-image info).
   574	        FIXED-BANDS mode feeds this in place of per-image pose, giving the CLIP-text part
   575	        queries a fixed anatomical localization prior (head top -> ankles bottom)."""
   576	        if self._canon_hm_cache is None:
   577	            H, W = 96, 32
   578	            KP = [(0.50, 0.06), (0.46, 0.05), (0.54, 0.05), (0.42, 0.06), (0.58, 0.06),
   579	                  (0.36, 0.18), (0.64, 0.18), (0.32, 0.32), (0.68, 0.32), (0.30, 0.45), (0.70, 0.45),
   580	                  (0.40, 0.50), (0.60, 0.50), (0.41, 0.72), (0.59, 0.72), (0.42, 0.95), (0.58, 0.95)]
   581	            ys = torch.arange(H, dtype=torch.float32).view(H, 1)
   582	            xs = torch.arange(W, dtype=torch.float32).view(1, W)
   583	            hm = torch.zeros(1, 17, H, W)
   584	            sx, sy = 0.12 * W, 0.05 * H
   585	            for k, (nx, ny) in enumerate(KP):
   586	                cx, cy = nx * W, ny * H
   587	                hm[0, k] = torch.exp(-(((xs - cx) ** 2) / (2 * sx ** 2) + ((ys - cy) ** 2) / (2 * sy ** 2)))
   588	            self._canon_hm_cache = hm
   589	        return self._canon_hm_cache.to(device).expand(B, 17, -1, -1).contiguous()
   590	
   591	    def _pgpd_loss(self, img_proj, txt_proto, label, scene_heatmaps, target_heatmaps=None):
   592	        """exp355 PGPD: pose-guided prompt-prototype dark-knowledge distillation.
   593	        Pose selects a more-complete same-ID teacher within the batch; distill the
   594	        teacher's soft distribution over the batch's OTHER-ID prototypes (hard-negatives)
   595	        to the (occluded) student. Training-only: no test-time pose, no new ID pathway in
   596	        the CLIP alignment, descriptor unchanged. Returns a scalar loss tensor.
   597	        target_heatmaps (target person only) is used for completeness so a distractor in a
   598	        multi-person scene cannot inflate it (Codex Medium)."""
   599	        import torch.nn.functional as F
   600	        B = img_proj.shape[0]
   601	        device = img_proj.device
   602	        # unique ID prototypes within the batch. Same-ID images share an identical prototype
   603	        # because exp355 keeps POSE_CLIP_ID_POSE_PROMPT off (prototype depends only on label),
   604	        # so scattering by inverse index is consistent.
   605	        uniq_labels, inv = torch.unique(label, return_inverse=True)   # inv: (B,) in [0,P)
   606	        P = uniq_labels.shape[0]
   607	        if P < 3:
   608	            return img_proj.new_zeros(())          # need >=2 hard-negatives for a soft target
   609	        uniq_protos = img_proj.new_zeros(P, txt_proto.shape[1], dtype=torch.float32)  # fp32: match txt_proto.float() (AMP index_put dtype)
   610	        uniq_protos[inv] = txt_proto.float()
   611	        # image-to-ID-prototype logits (fp32 for softmax stability under AMP)
   612	        img_n = F.normalize(img_proj.float(), dim=1)
   613	        proto_n = F.normalize(uniq_protos, dim=1)
   614	        logits = img_n @ proto_n.t() / self.pgpd_tau           # (B, P)
   615	        # TARGET pose completeness per image (sum of per-keypoint peak activation), detached.
   616	        # Use target_heatmaps (target person only), NOT scene_heatmaps (max-merged over all
   617	        # persons) — else a distractor can inflate completeness while the target is occluded,
   618	        # driving teacher selection by non-target pose (Codex Medium). Fall back to scene only
   619	        # if target is unavailable.
   620	        comp_hm = target_heatmaps if target_heatmaps is not None else scene_heatmaps
   621	        comp = comp_hm.float().amax(dim=(2, 3)).sum(dim=1).detach()   # (B,)
   622	        same = label.view(B, 1) == label.view(1, B)            # (B, B)
   623	        not_self = ~torch.eye(B, dtype=torch.bool, device=device)
   624	        if self.pgpd_random_teacher:
   625	            cand = same & not_self                             # control: any same-ID teacher
   626	            score = torch.rand(B, B, device=device)            # random pick among candidates
   627	        else:
   628	            cand = same & (comp.view(1, B) > comp.view(B, 1)) & not_self  # teacher strictly more complete
   629	            score = comp.view(1, B).expand(B, B)               # pick the most-complete teacher
   630	        score = torch.where(cand, score, score.new_full((B, B), -1e9))
   631	        teacher_idx = score.argmax(dim=1)                      # (B,)
   632	        has_teacher = cand.any(dim=1)                          # (B,)
   633	        # hard-negative mask: drop each student's true-ID column (= inv). The teacher shares the
   634	        # same label, so the same column is its true ID too.
   635	        neg_mask = torch.ones(B, P, dtype=torch.bool, device=device)
   636	        neg_mask[torch.arange(B, device=device), inv] = False
   637	        student_logp = F.log_softmax(logits.masked_fill(~neg_mask, float('-inf')), dim=1)   # (B,P)
   638	        teacher_p = F.softmax(logits[teacher_idx].masked_fill(~neg_mask, float('-inf')), dim=1).detach()
   639	        # cross-entropy KD over hard-negatives; zero the masked column to avoid 0*(-inf)=NaN
   640	        prod = (teacher_p * student_logp).masked_fill(~neg_mask, 0.0)
   641	        dark = -prod.sum(dim=1)                                # (B,)
   642	        dark = torch.nan_to_num(dark, nan=0.0, posinf=0.0, neginf=0.0)
   643	        # weight: how much more complete the teacher is; 0 for students with no teacher
   644	        if self.pgpd_random_teacher:
   645	            w = has_teacher.float()
   646	        else:
   647	            w = (comp[teacher_idx] - comp).clamp(min=0.0) * has_teacher.float()
   648	        pgpd = (w * dark).sum() / w.sum().clamp(min=1e-6)
   649	        if not getattr(self, '_pgpd_logged', False):
   650	            self._pgpd_logged = True
   651	            print('[PGPD] first-call diag: teacher coverage %d/%d, mean_w %.3f, mean_dark %.3f, P %d'
   652	                  % (int(has_teacher.sum()), B, float(w.mean()), float(dark.mean()), P))
   653	        return self.pgpd_w * pgpd
   654	
   655	    def _pcmsc_loss(self, featmap, img, scene_heatmaps):
   656	        """exp356 PC-MSC: pose-masked CLIP-semantic completion. Mask a (visible) region's
   657	        backbone tokens; reconstruct that region's frozen CLIP-visual feature from the visible
   658	        context. Training-only regularizer; the descriptor (global) is computed on the UNMASKED
   659	        featmap elsewhere. Returns a scalar loss tensor."""
   660	        import torch.nn.functional as F
   661	        B, C, H, W = featmap.shape
   662	        device = featmap.device
   663	        target = self.pcmsc_visual.part_targets(img)            # (B,3,clip_dim) frozen, fp32, detached
   664	        # region of each token by row (5/6/5 split of H ~ CLIP 16-grid head/torso/legs thirds)
   665	        h1, h2 = round(5.0 / 16 * H), round(11.0 / 16 * H)
   666	        h1 = max(1, min(h1, H - 2)); h2 = max(h1 + 1, min(h2, H - 1))
   667	        rows = torch.arange(H, device=device).repeat_interleave(W)       # (HW,)
   668	        region_of_token = (rows >= h1).long() + (rows >= h2).long()      # (HW,) in {0,1,2}
   669	        # per-region pose visibility
   670	        pose = F.interpolate(scene_heatmaps.float(), size=(H, W), mode='bilinear', align_corners=False)
   671	        vis_map = pose.amax(dim=1).flatten(1)                            # (B, HW)
   672	        reg_vis = torch.stack([vis_map[:, region_of_token == r].mean(1) for r in range(3)], dim=1)  # (B,3)
   673	        # select region to mask: visibility-weighted (pose) or uniform (control)
   674	        if self.pcmsc_random_mask:
   675	            sel = torch.randint(0, 3, (B,), device=device)
   676	        else:
   677	            sel = torch.multinomial(reg_vis.clamp(min=1e-6).softmax(dim=1), 1).squeeze(1)  # (B,)
   678	        # mask the selected region's tokens with the learnable mask token
   679	        tokens = featmap.flatten(2).transpose(1, 2)                      # (B, HW, C)
   680	        mask = (region_of_token.unsqueeze(0) == sel.unsqueeze(1))        # (B, HW) bool
   681	        mt = self.pcmsc_mask_token.view(1, 1, C).to(tokens.dtype)
   682	        tok_masked = torch.where(mask.unsqueeze(-1), mt, tokens)
   683	        # decoder: the selected region's query reconstructs from the (masked) token set
   684	        q = self.pcmsc_query[sel].unsqueeze(1).to(tokens.dtype)          # (B,1,C)
   685	        R = self.pcmsc_decoder(q, tok_masked, tok_masked)[0].squeeze(1)  # (B, C)
   686	        R = F.normalize(self.pcmsc_proj(R).float(), dim=-1)             # (B, clip_dim) fp32
   687	        tgt = target[torch.arange(B, device=device), sel]               # (B, clip_dim)
   688	        cos = (R * tgt).sum(-1)
   689	        loss = (1.0 - cos).mean()
   690	        if not getattr(self, '_pcmsc_logged', False):
   691	            self._pcmsc_logged = True
   692	            print('[PC-MSC] first-call diag: sel-region hist %s, mean cos %.3f'
   693	                  % (torch.bincount(sel, minlength=3).tolist(), float(cos.mean())))
   694	        return self.pcmsc_w * loss
   695	
   696	    def _lgpa_heatmap(self, scene_heatmaps, B, device):
   697	        """Select the heatmap fed to the LGPA head: None (no-pose), fixed canonical
   698	        (fixed-bands), or per-image scene heatmaps (default)."""
   699	        if getattr(self, '_lgpa_no_pose', False):
   700	            return None
   701	        if getattr(self, '_lgpa_fixed_bands', False):
   702	            return self._canonical_heatmap(B, device)
   703	        return scene_heatmaps

experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage.md:8478:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_laststage_design.md:12278:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:13581:experiments/exp349b_small_undetach_clip/claude_review.md:82:- **风险点不在训练而在 eval**：config TEST.IMS_PER_BATCH=256（line 77）。按项目铁律（experiment_protocol.md），所有训练启动必须 CLI override **`TEST.IMS_PER_BATCH 64`**，否则 384×128 + flip-test TTA 在 e80 fragmentation 下历史上 OOM 过两次。⚠️ **启动命令务必加 `TEST.IMS_PER_BATCH 64`**（这是流程要求，config 本身保留 256 可接受，但启动必须 override）。

experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_dg_deepen.md:4745:experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:15:在 exp260b 的 dual-forward（occluded student / clean teacher）之上，对 GCN 的 17 个 per-keypoint token 加一个 **VisibilityConditionedNorm（VCN）模块** + **可见性条件统计对齐 loss（VCA）**：训练时把 student 路被遮挡 token 的 per-keypoint per-channel 归一化统计对齐到 teacher（clean）路同 keypoint 的统计，能消掉「遮挡 domain 轴」、让 visible-part 表示对有/无遮挡鲁棒，从而把 Market→Occluded-ReID 跨域 mAP 抬过 88.0。

**Verdict: needs-attention**

修前不建议开跑。`ss_episode_loss` 公式和 P×K 检查基本正确，train/eval batch 解包也基本对；但当前脚本有启动级接口错误。

**Findings**
- **Critical** [ss_cvar_laststage.py](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp367_single_support/ss_cvar_laststage.py:248): `make_optimizer(cfg, model)` 调用错误。项目实现是 `make_optimizer(cfg, model, center_criterion)`，并返回 `(optimizer, optimizer_center)`，见 [make_optimizer.py](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/solver/make_optimizer.py:4)。当前会直接 `TypeError`，训练无法启动。应改成保留 `center_criterion` 并解包 optimizer。

- **High** [ss_cvar_laststage.py](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp367_single_support/ss_cvar_laststage.py:287): `scheduler.step()` 少传 `epoch`。当前 `create_scheduler` 返回的项目 scheduler 要求 `step(epoch)`，见 [scheduler.py](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/solver/scheduler.py:67)，标准 processor 也是 `scheduler.step(epoch)`。修完 optimizer 后会在 epoch 1 结束崩。

- **Medium** [ss_cvar_laststage.py](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp367_single_support/ss_cvar_laststage.py:220): 评估口径只保留 full/random/worst，没有 probe v2 的 best-support、best-worst gap、random/worst false10 输出。核心 mAP 计算、common-valid、distractor 全量、missing-positive=0 是对的，但证据链弱于 [probe v2](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp367_single_support/cvpb_single_support_probe.py:101)，不够支撑“gap 缩小/false10 非 trivial”判断。

- **Low** [ss_cvar_laststage.py](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp367_single_support/ss_cvar_laststage.py:84): 解冻范围确实覆盖 `base.stages[-1] + bottleneck + classifier`，但会把原本冻结的 BNNeck bias 重新设成可训练；原始模型显式 `bottleneck.bias.requires_grad_(False)`，见 [make_model.py](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/model/make_model.py:237)。另外 Swin 的 `base.norm3` 在 `stages[-1]` 外，仍被冻结，严格说不是完整 last-stage 输出层 FT。

- **Low** [ss_cvar_laststage.py](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp367_single_support/ss_cvar_laststage.py:154): `call_project_loss` 捕获所有 `TypeError` 后静默降级，可能掩盖 loss 内部真实 bug。当前项目 `make_loss` 支持 `kp_data`，正常不会触发，但这里最好只做显式签名兼容或直接调用。

**通过项**
- `make_model(cfg, num_classes, cam_num, view_num, cfg.MODEL.SEMANTIC_WEIGHT)`、`make_dataloader` 7 返回、`model.load_param()`、pose/non-pose forward 签名匹配。
- pose train batch 是 `(img, target, cam, view, pose_dict)`；普通 batch 是 `(img, target, cam, view)`。目标 config `softmax_triplet` 下 `RandomIdentitySampler` 会按 pid 连续追加 K 张，`ss_episode_loss` 的 label 检查能兜底。
- `ss_episode_loss` 是 two-level CVaR：support slot risk `[P,K]`，先 query CE，再每 ID top-tail CVaR，数学上对。
- AMP 基本安全；`tau=0.1` 下 normalized dot logits 范围可控。`set_frozen_bn_eval` 对冻结 BN 合理。Swin `WITH_CP=True` 不构成阻塞，因为 block 只在 `x.requires_grad` 时 checkpoint。
- 3 mode 隔离基本成立：`plain=base`，`random=base+ss_ce`，`cvar=base+ss_ce+lam*cvar`。

- **Low** [ss_cvar_laststage.py](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp367_single_support/ss_cvar_laststage.py:84): 解冻范围确实覆盖 `base.stages[-1] + bottleneck + classifier`，但会把原本冻结的 BNNeck bias 重新设成可训练；原始模型显式 `bottleneck.bias.requires_grad_(False)`，见 [make_model.py](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/model/make_model.py:237)。另外 Swin 的 `base.norm3` 在 `stages[-1]` 外，仍被冻结，严格说不是完整 last-stage 输出层 FT。

- **Low** [ss_cvar_laststage.py](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp367_single_support/ss_cvar_laststage.py:154): `call_project_loss` 捕获所有 `TypeError` 后静默降级，可能掩盖 loss 内部真实 bug。当前项目 `make_loss` 支持 `kp_data`，正常不会触发，但这里最好只做显式签名兼容或直接调用。

**通过项**
- `make_model(cfg, num_classes, cam_num, view_num, cfg.MODEL.SEMANTIC_WEIGHT)`、`make_dataloader` 7 返回、`model.load_param()`、pose/non-pose forward 签名匹配。
- pose train batch 是 `(img, target, cam, view, pose_dict)`；普通 batch 是 `(img, target, cam, view)`。目标 config `softmax_triplet` 下 `RandomIdentitySampler` 会按 pid 连续追加 K 张，`ss_episode_loss` 的 label 检查能兜底。
- `ss_episode_loss` 是 two-level CVaR：support slot risk `[P,K]`，先 query CE，再每 ID top-tail CVaR，数学上对。
- AMP 基本安全；`tau=0.1` 下 normalized dot logits 范围可控。`set_frozen_bn_eval` 对冻结 BN 合理。Swin `WITH_CP=True` 不构成阻塞，因为 block 只在 `x.requires_grad` 时 checkpoint。
- 3 mode 隔离基本成立：`plain=base`，`random=base+ss_ce`，`cvar=base+ss_ce+lam*cvar`。

experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review.md:5341:./experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:3:> **来源**：post-PRCV「搬范式 / 重定义问题」路线。前置探针 `scripts/vcnorm_probe.py`（commit e3a709b）已证前提成立：在 Market 全可见训练的 exp260b 模型上，Occluded-ReID 被遮挡部位的 per-part GCN token 归一化统计（per-channel mean/var）漂到与可见 token 明显不同、近完美线性可分的区（pre-GCN KL≈288 / LDA-AUC≈0.97，post-GCN 仍 KL 数十 / AUC≈0.8），且 3 个对照证明不是采样伪影。**遮挡 = 未对齐的 domain factor**。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review.md:5342:./experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:5:> **baseline**：exp260b（Swin-Base + 2-stage PSG + LGPA-D + GCN512 + OA-SD + PLBOA），Market 训练 → Occluded-ReID 跨域 = **88.0 mAP（MaxSim + flip）**。目标 **> 88.0**。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review.md:5343:./experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:9:exp260b 已有 OA-SD（occluded student ↔ clean EMA teacher 双前向）+ PLBOA（下肢遮挡增广），但其蒸馏只作用在 **pooled global 特征**（cosine）。BT-PKD 进一步蒸馏 per-keypoint 特征**方向**（cosine），仍是「让被遮挡 token 的特征向 clean token 看齐」。两者都没有触碰探针指认的真正病灶：**被遮挡 per-part token 的归一化统计（一阶/二阶矩）整体漂移到一个可分离的子空间**——这是一条「有/无遮挡」的 domain 轴，叠加在身份信号上。OA-SD/BT-PKD 把个体特征拉近，但没有显式消掉这条 domain 轴；探针显示这条轴在跨域时大量残留（pre-GCN AUC 0.97），GCN 只部分修复。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review.md:5344:./experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:15:在 exp260b 的 dual-forward（occluded student / clean teacher）之上，对 GCN 的 17 个 per-keypoint token 加一个 **VisibilityConditionedNorm（VCN）模块** + **可见性条件统计对齐 loss（VCA）**：训练时把 student 路被遮挡 token 的 per-keypoint per-channel 归一化统计对齐到 teacher（clean）路同 keypoint 的统计，能消掉「遮挡 domain 轴」、让 visible-part 表示对有/无遮挡鲁棒，从而把 Market→Occluded-ReID 跨域 mAP 抬过 88.0。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review.md:5345:./experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:61:   - **复用现成 dual-forward**：exp260b 已是 `parallel_oa_sd`（3 occluded student + 1 clean teacher），teacher 前向已在 OA-SD 段算出 `teacher_kp_data`，**VCA 不新增前向、不增显存峰值的额外 backbone pass**。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review.md:5348:./experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:93:  - VC-Norm 净增益**只能 vs 这条对照**，**不能 vs 原 exp260b 88.0**（后者 PLBOA=False，是另一条 baseline）。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review.md:5349:./experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:94:- **PLBOA 说明（重要）**：exp260b 原 config `POSE_LOWER_BODY_OCC=False`，此时 OA-SD 的 teacher≈student（代码已 warning「near-identical images」），OA-SD 近退化。VC-Norm 要 occluded-vs-clean 的对比信号**必须开 PLBOA**，故本实验与对照都设 `POSE_LOWER_BODY_OCC=True`。因此严格单变量对照是「同 PLBOA、VC-Norm 开/关」，**不是** vs 原 exp260b 88.0（后者 PLBOA 关）。88.0 仅作量级参照；若开 PLBOA 的 VC-Norm-OFF 对照已偏离 88.0，以对照为准。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review.md:5360:./experiments/exp328_vcnorm/claude_review.md:7:processor.py wiring / config(defaults.py + pose_vcnorm_base.yml) / dryrun_unit.py / 优化器 / train-test 对称 / AMP / 与 exp260b 复现性交互
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review.md:5361:./experiments/exp328_vcnorm/claude_review.md:26:- 单变量对照设计正确：design.md §对照组明确"严格单变量 = 同 PLBOA、VC-Norm 开/关"，并诚实说明**不是** vs 原 exp260b 88.0（原 exp260b PLBOA=False），88.0 仅作量级参照。这一点处理得对（见下方 High-1 的隐患）。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review.md:5362:./experiments/exp328_vcnorm/claude_review.md:68:- **High-1 [实验设计 / 对照基线]**：yml 与 exp260b baseline 的差异不止 VC-Norm 一项——本 yml `POSE_LOWER_BODY_OCC=True`，而原 exp260b 88.0 是 `POSE_LOWER_BODY_OCC=False` 跑出来的。VC-Norm 需要 PLBOA 提供 occluded-vs-clean 信号，所以开 PLBOA 是必须的，但这意味着 **"88.0"不能直接当对照**。design.md 已经诚实指出这点，但**必须实跑 VC-Norm-OFF + PLBOA-ON 的对照实验**才能算 VC-Norm 净增益，否则结论无效。

experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review.md:6967:./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_raw_r2.md:5510:./experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:15:在 exp260b 的 dual-forward（occluded student / clean teacher）之上，对 GCN 的 17 个 per-keypoint token 加一个 **VisibilityConditionedNorm（VCN）模块** + **可见性条件统计对齐 loss（VCA）**：训练时把 student 路被遮挡 token 的 per-keypoint per-channel 归一化统计对齐到 teacher（clean）路同 keypoint 的统计，能消掉「遮挡 domain 轴」、让 visible-part 表示对有/无遮挡鲁棒，从而把 Market→Occluded-ReID 跨域 mAP 抬过 88.0。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review.md:7017:./experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:3544:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:12655:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/RANKREGRET_RESULT.md:21:→ **没有一个 stage 既便宜又有用**: stage0/1（省 83-92% 算力）特征近乎随机（mAP 0.2-1.2）; stage2（第一个可用特征 48/91）只省 8%。任何 cascade 都被这堵墙卡死。（FULL mAP 与训练端 exp255/exp260b 一致, 抽取干净。）
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review.md:7247:./experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:7235:experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:9:exp260b 已有 OA-SD（occluded student ↔ clean EMA teacher 双前向）+ PLBOA（下肢遮挡增广），但其蒸馏只作用在 **pooled global 特征**（cosine）。BT-PKD 进一步蒸馏 per-keypoint 特征**方向**（cosine），仍是「让被遮挡 token 的特征向 clean token 看齐」。两者都没有触碰探针指认的真正病灶：**被遮挡 per-part token 的归一化统计（一阶/二阶矩）整体漂移到一个可分离的子空间**——这是一条「有/无遮挡」的 domain 轴，叠加在身份信号上。OA-SD/BT-PKD 把个体特征拉近，但没有显式消掉这条 domain 轴；探针显示这条轴在跨域时大量残留（pre-GCN AUC 0.97），GCN 只部分修复。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review.md:7248:./experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:7236:experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:15:在 exp260b 的 dual-forward（occluded student / clean teacher）之上，对 GCN 的 17 个 per-keypoint token 加一个 **VisibilityConditionedNorm（VCN）模块** + **可见性条件统计对齐 loss（VCA）**：训练时把 student 路被遮挡 token 的 per-keypoint per-channel 归一化统计对齐到 teacher（clean）路同 keypoint 的统计，能消掉「遮挡 domain 轴」、让 visible-part 表示对有/无遮挡鲁棒，从而把 Market→Occluded-ReID 跨域 mAP 抬过 88.0。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review.md:7249:./experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:7246:experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:61:   - **复用现成 dual-forward**：exp260b 已是 `parallel_oa_sd`（3 occluded student + 1 clean teacher），teacher 前向已在 OA-SD 段算出 `teacher_kp_data`，**VCA 不新增前向、不增显存峰值的额外 backbone pass**。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review.md:7250:./experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:7253:experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:94:- **PLBOA 说明（重要）**：exp260b 原 config `POSE_LOWER_BODY_OCC=False`，此时 OA-SD 的 teacher≈student（代码已 warning「near-identical images」），OA-SD 近退化。VC-Norm 要 occluded-vs-clean 的对比信号**必须开 PLBOA**，故本实验与对照都设 `POSE_LOWER_BODY_OCC=True`。因此严格单变量对照是「同 PLBOA、VC-Norm 开/关」，**不是** vs 原 exp260b 88.0（后者 PLBOA 关）。88.0 仅作量级参照；若开 PLBOA 的 VC-Norm-OFF 对照已偏离 88.0，以对照为准。

experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review.md:7325:./experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:12399:experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:3:> **来源**：post-PRCV「搬范式 / 重定义问题」路线。前置探针 `scripts/vcnorm_probe.py`（commit e3a709b）已证前提成立：在 Market 全可见训练的 exp260b 模型上，Occluded-ReID 被遮挡部位的 per-part GCN token 归一化统计（per-channel mean/var）漂到与可见 token 明显不同、近完美线性可分的区（pre-GCN KL≈288 / LDA-AUC≈0.97，post-GCN 仍 KL 数十 / AUC≈0.8），且 3 个对照证明不是采样伪影。**遮挡 = 未对齐的 domain factor**。

experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_laststage_design.md:5469:experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:3:> **来源**：post-PRCV「搬范式 / 重定义问题」路线。前置探针 `scripts/vcnorm_probe.py`（commit e3a709b）已证前提成立：在 Market 全可见训练的 exp260b 模型上，Occluded-ReID 被遮挡部位的 per-part GCN token 归一化统计（per-channel mean/var）漂到与可见 token 明显不同、近完美线性可分的区（pre-GCN KL≈288 / LDA-AUC≈0.97，post-GCN 仍 KL 数十 / AUC≈0.8），且 3 个对照证明不是采样伪影。**遮挡 = 未对齐的 domain factor**。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_laststage_design.md:5470:experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:5:> **baseline**：exp260b（Swin-Base + 2-stage PSG + LGPA-D + GCN512 + OA-SD + PLBOA），Market 训练 → Occluded-ReID 跨域 = **88.0 mAP（MaxSim + flip）**。目标 **> 88.0**。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_laststage_design.md:5471:experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:9:exp260b 已有 OA-SD（occluded student ↔ clean EMA teacher 双前向）+ PLBOA（下肢遮挡增广），但其蒸馏只作用在 **pooled global 特征**（cosine）。BT-PKD 进一步蒸馏 per-keypoint 特征**方向**（cosine），仍是「让被遮挡 token 的特征向 clean token 看齐」。两者都没有触碰探针指认的真正病灶：**被遮挡 per-part token 的归一化统计（一阶/二阶矩）整体漂移到一个可分离的子空间**——这是一条「有/无遮挡」的 domain 轴，叠加在身份信号上。OA-SD/BT-PKD 把个体特征拉近，但没有显式消掉这条 domain 轴；探针显示这条轴在跨域时大量残留（pre-GCN AUC 0.97），GCN 只部分修复。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_laststage_design.md:5472:experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:15:在 exp260b 的 dual-forward（occluded student / clean teacher）之上，对 GCN 的 17 个 per-keypoint token 加一个 **VisibilityConditionedNorm（VCN）模块** + **可见性条件统计对齐 loss（VCA）**：训练时把 student 路被遮挡 token 的 per-keypoint per-channel 归一化统计对齐到 teacher（clean）路同 keypoint 的统计，能消掉「遮挡 domain 轴」、让 visible-part 表示对有/无遮挡鲁棒，从而把 Market→Occluded-ReID 跨域 mAP 抬过 88.0。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_laststage_design.md:5473:experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:61:   - **复用现成 dual-forward**：exp260b 已是 `parallel_oa_sd`（3 occluded student + 1 clean teacher），teacher 前向已在 OA-SD 段算出 `teacher_kp_data`，**VCA 不新增前向、不增显存峰值的额外 backbone pass**。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_laststage_design.md:5474:experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:93:  - VC-Norm 净增益**只能 vs 这条对照**，**不能 vs 原 exp260b 88.0**（后者 PLBOA=False，是另一条 baseline）。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_laststage_design.md:5475:experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:94:- **PLBOA 说明（重要）**：exp260b 原 config `POSE_LOWER_BODY_OCC=False`，此时 OA-SD 的 teacher≈student（代码已 warning「near-identical images」），OA-SD 近退化。VC-Norm 要 occluded-vs-clean 的对比信号**必须开 PLBOA**，故本实验与对照都设 `POSE_LOWER_BODY_OCC=True`。因此严格单变量对照是「同 PLBOA、VC-Norm 开/关」，**不是** vs 原 exp260b 88.0（后者 PLBOA 关）。88.0 仅作量级参照；若开 PLBOA 的 VC-Norm-OFF 对照已偏离 88.0，以对照为准。

experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_laststage_design.md:5480:experiments/exp328_vcnorm/claude_review.md:26:- 单变量对照设计正确：design.md §对照组明确"严格单变量 = 同 PLBOA、VC-Norm 开/关"，并诚实说明**不是** vs 原 exp260b 88.0（原 exp260b PLBOA=False），88.0 仅作量级参照。这一点处理得对（见下方 High-1 的隐患）。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_laststage_design.md:5481:experiments/exp328_vcnorm/claude_review.md:68:- **High-1 [实验设计 / 对照基线]**：yml 与 exp260b baseline 的差异不止 VC-Norm 一项——本 yml `POSE_LOWER_BODY_OCC=True`，而原 exp260b 88.0 是 `POSE_LOWER_BODY_OCC=False` 跑出来的。VC-Norm 需要 PLBOA 提供 occluded-vs-clean 信号，所以开 PLBOA 是必须的，但这意味着 **"88.0"不能直接当对照**。design.md 已经诚实指出这点，但**必须实跑 VC-Norm-OFF + PLBOA-ON 的对照实验**才能算 VC-Norm 净增益，否则结论无效。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_laststage_design.md:5482:experiments/prcv_2026_psg/todo.md:58:> **2026-04-19 更新**：本地 3090 挂了，Base 3 个 run 全部推迟（decision C）。但用户确认 `MODEL.WITH_CP: True`（已在 prcv_best_base.yml 打开）下 Base 显存只 6–8 GB，5060 Ti 16G 完全够。当前三台正在跑 Tiny/Small 6 run，完成后 Base 3 run 并排进 Phase 1。论文主表 Base 行短期仍可引 `exp260b = 73.9/83.2`（旧协议）。

experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_laststage_design.md:5696:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review.md:5341:./experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:3:> **来源**：post-PRCV「搬范式 / 重定义问题」路线。前置探针 `scripts/vcnorm_probe.py`（commit e3a709b）已证前提成立：在 Market 全可见训练的 exp260b 模型上，Occluded-ReID 被遮挡部位的 per-part GCN token 归一化统计（per-channel mean/var）漂到与可见 token 明显不同、近完美线性可分的区（pre-GCN KL≈288 / LDA-AUC≈0.97，post-GCN 仍 KL 数十 / AUC≈0.8），且 3 个对照证明不是采样伪影。**遮挡 = 未对齐的 domain factor**。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_laststage_design.md:5697:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review.md:5342:./experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:5:> **baseline**：exp260b（Swin-Base + 2-stage PSG + LGPA-D + GCN512 + OA-SD + PLBOA），Market 训练 → Occluded-ReID 跨域 = **88.0 mAP（MaxSim + flip）**。目标 **> 88.0**。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_laststage_design.md:5698:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review.md:5343:./experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:9:exp260b 已有 OA-SD（occluded student ↔ clean EMA teacher 双前向）+ PLBOA（下肢遮挡增广），但其蒸馏只作用在 **pooled global 特征**（cosine）。BT-PKD 进一步蒸馏 per-keypoint 特征**方向**（cosine），仍是「让被遮挡 token 的特征向 clean token 看齐」。两者都没有触碰探针指认的真正病灶：**被遮挡 per-part token 的归一化统计（一阶/二阶矩）整体漂移到一个可分离的子空间**——这是一条「有/无遮挡」的 domain 轴，叠加在身份信号上。OA-SD/BT-PKD 把个体特征拉近，但没有显式消掉这条 domain 轴；探针显示这条轴在跨域时大量残留（pre-GCN AUC 0.97），GCN 只部分修复。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_laststage_design.md:5699:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review.md:5344:./experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:15:在 exp260b 的 dual-forward（occluded student / clean teacher）之上，对 GCN 的 17 个 per-keypoint token 加一个 **VisibilityConditionedNorm（VCN）模块** + **可见性条件统计对齐 loss（VCA）**：训练时把 student 路被遮挡 token 的 per-keypoint per-channel 归一化统计对齐到 teacher（clean）路同 keypoint 的统计，能消掉「遮挡 domain 轴」、让 visible-part 表示对有/无遮挡鲁棒，从而把 Market→Occluded-ReID 跨域 mAP 抬过 88.0。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_laststage_design.md:5700:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review.md:5345:./experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:61:   - **复用现成 dual-forward**：exp260b 已是 `parallel_oa_sd`（3 occluded student + 1 clean teacher），teacher 前向已在 OA-SD 段算出 `teacher_kp_data`，**VCA 不新增前向、不增显存峰值的额外 backbone pass**。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_laststage_design.md:5701:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review.md:5348:./experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:93:  - VC-Norm 净增益**只能 vs 这条对照**，**不能 vs 原 exp260b 88.0**（后者 PLBOA=False，是另一条 baseline）。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_laststage_design.md:5702:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review.md:5349:./experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:94:- **PLBOA 说明（重要）**：exp260b 原 config `POSE_LOWER_BODY_OCC=False`，此时 OA-SD 的 teacher≈student（代码已 warning「near-identical images」），OA-SD 近退化。VC-Norm 要 occluded-vs-clean 的对比信号**必须开 PLBOA**，故本实验与对照都设 `POSE_LOWER_BODY_OCC=True`。因此严格单变量对照是「同 PLBOA、VC-Norm 开/关」，**不是** vs 原 exp260b 88.0（后者 PLBOA 关）。88.0 仅作量级参照；若开 PLBOA 的 VC-Norm-OFF 对照已偏离 88.0，以对照为准。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_laststage_design.md:5703:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review.md:5360:./experiments/exp328_vcnorm/claude_review.md:7:processor.py wiring / config(defaults.py + pose_vcnorm_base.yml) / dryrun_unit.py / 优化器 / train-test 对称 / AMP / 与 exp260b 复现性交互
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_laststage_design.md:5704:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review.md:5361:./experiments/exp328_vcnorm/claude_review.md:26:- 单变量对照设计正确：design.md §对照组明确"严格单变量 = 同 PLBOA、VC-Norm 开/关"，并诚实说明**不是** vs 原 exp260b 88.0（原 exp260b PLBOA=False），88.0 仅作量级参照。这一点处理得对（见下方 High-1 的隐患）。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_laststage_design.md:5705:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review.md:5362:./experiments/exp328_vcnorm/claude_review.md:68:- **High-1 [实验设计 / 对照基线]**：yml 与 exp260b baseline 的差异不止 VC-Norm 一项——本 yml `POSE_LOWER_BODY_OCC=True`，而原 exp260b 88.0 是 `POSE_LOWER_BODY_OCC=False` 跑出来的。VC-Norm 需要 PLBOA 提供 occluded-vs-clean 信号，所以开 PLBOA 是必须的，但这意味着 **"88.0"不能直接当对照**。design.md 已经诚实指出这点，但**必须实跑 VC-Norm-OFF + PLBOA-ON 的对照实验**才能算 VC-Norm 净增益，否则结论无效。

experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_laststage_design.md:5887:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review.md:6956:./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_raw_r2.md:4608:./experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:7246:experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:61:   - **复用现成 dual-forward**：exp260b 已是 `parallel_oa_sd`（3 occluded student + 1 clean teacher），teacher 前向已在 OA-SD 段算出 `teacher_kp_data`，**VCA 不新增前向、不增显存峰值的额外 backbone pass**。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_laststage_design.md:5888:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review.md:6967:./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_raw_r2.md:5510:./experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:15:在 exp260b 的 dual-forward（occluded student / clean teacher）之上，对 GCN 的 17 个 per-keypoint token 加一个 **VisibilityConditionedNorm（VCN）模块** + **可见性条件统计对齐 loss（VCA）**：训练时把 student 路被遮挡 token 的 per-keypoint per-channel 归一化统计对齐到 teacher（clean）路同 keypoint 的统计，能消掉「遮挡 domain 轴」、让 visible-part 表示对有/无遮挡鲁棒，从而把 Market→Occluded-ReID 跨域 mAP 抬过 88.0。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_laststage_design.md:5889:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review.md:7017:./experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:3544:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:12655:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/RANKREGRET_RESULT.md:21:→ **没有一个 stage 既便宜又有用**: stage0/1（省 83-92% 算力）特征近乎随机（mAP 0.2-1.2）; stage2（第一个可用特征 48/91）只省 8%。任何 cascade 都被这堵墙卡死。（FULL mAP 与训练端 exp255/exp260b 一致, 抽取干净。）
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_laststage_design.md:5890:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review.md:7247:./experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:7235:experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:9:exp260b 已有 OA-SD（occluded student ↔ clean EMA teacher 双前向）+ PLBOA（下肢遮挡增广），但其蒸馏只作用在 **pooled global 特征**（cosine）。BT-PKD 进一步蒸馏 per-keypoint 特征**方向**（cosine），仍是「让被遮挡 token 的特征向 clean token 看齐」。两者都没有触碰探针指认的真正病灶：**被遮挡 per-part token 的归一化统计（一阶/二阶矩）整体漂移到一个可分离的子空间**——这是一条「有/无遮挡」的 domain 轴，叠加在身份信号上。OA-SD/BT-PKD 把个体特征拉近，但没有显式消掉这条 domain 轴；探针显示这条轴在跨域时大量残留（pre-GCN AUC 0.97），GCN 只部分修复。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_laststage_design.md:5891:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review.md:7248:./experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:7236:experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:15:在 exp260b 的 dual-forward（occluded student / clean teacher）之上，对 GCN 的 17 个 per-keypoint token 加一个 **VisibilityConditionedNorm（VCN）模块** + **可见性条件统计对齐 loss（VCA）**：训练时把 student 路被遮挡 token 的 per-keypoint per-channel 归一化统计对齐到 teacher（clean）路同 keypoint 的统计，能消掉「遮挡 domain 轴」、让 visible-part 表示对有/无遮挡鲁棒，从而把 Market→Occluded-ReID 跨域 mAP 抬过 88.0。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_laststage_design.md:5892:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review.md:7249:./experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:7246:experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:61:   - **复用现成 dual-forward**：exp260b 已是 `parallel_oa_sd`（3 occluded student + 1 clean teacher），teacher 前向已在 OA-SD 段算出 `teacher_kp_data`，**VCA 不新增前向、不增显存峰值的额外 backbone pass**。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_laststage_design.md:5893:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review.md:7250:./experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:7253:experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:94:- **PLBOA 说明（重要）**：exp260b 原 config `POSE_LOWER_BODY_OCC=False`，此时 OA-SD 的 teacher≈student（代码已 warning「near-identical images」），OA-SD 近退化。VC-Norm 要 occluded-vs-clean 的对比信号**必须开 PLBOA**，故本实验与对照都设 `POSE_LOWER_BODY_OCC=True`。因此严格单变量对照是「同 PLBOA、VC-Norm 开/关」，**不是** vs 原 exp260b 88.0（后者 PLBOA 关）。88.0 仅作量级参照；若开 PLBOA 的 VC-Norm-OFF 对照已偏离 88.0，以对照为准。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_laststage_design.md:5894:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review.md:7323:./experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:12390:experiments/decisions.md:4540:**资产**: 现成 Market-trained ckpt `log/market1501/exp260b_base_gcn512_2stage/transformer_120.pth`(Swin-Base+PSG+LGPA+GCN512), 现成跨域 eval `test_on_occluded_reid.py`(Market→Occluded-ReID 86.0/88.5 已存), 两域数据+pose 齐。脚本 `scripts/uce_calib_probe.py`, 结果 `log/uce_calib_probe.json`。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_laststage_design.md:5895:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review.md:7324:./experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:12393:experiments/decisions.md:4551:**资产**: Market-trained ckpt `log/market1501/exp260b_base_gcn512_2stage/transformer_120.pth`(Swin-Base+PSG+LGPA+GCN512, Occ-ReID baseline 88.0 mAP MaxSim+flip), 数据 Occluded-ReID(1000q/1000g+pose), env solider-reid(torch1.13+mmcv)。脚本 `scripts/vcnorm_probe.py`(主)+`scripts/vcnorm_probe_control.py`(对照), 结果 `experiments/vcnorm_probe/*.json` + README。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_laststage_design.md:5896:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review.md:7325:./experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:12399:experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:3:> **来源**：post-PRCV「搬范式 / 重定义问题」路线。前置探针 `scripts/vcnorm_probe.py`（commit e3a709b）已证前提成立：在 Market 全可见训练的 exp260b 模型上，Occluded-ReID 被遮挡部位的 per-part GCN token 归一化统计（per-channel mean/var）漂到与可见 token 明显不同、近完美线性可分的区（pre-GCN KL≈288 / LDA-AUC≈0.97，post-GCN 仍 KL 数十 / AUC≈0.8），且 3 个对照证明不是采样伪影。**遮挡 = 未对齐的 domain factor**。

experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage.md:17369:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:1839:experiments/exp328_vcnorm/codex_review.md:50:**原问题**：当前 yml（Swin-Base + PLBOA=True + VCNORM=True）不能直接对 exp260b 88.0
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage.md:17370:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:1889:experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:5:> **baseline**：exp260b（Swin-Base + 2-stage PSG + LGPA-D + GCN512 + OA-SD + PLBOA），Market 训练 → Occluded-ReID 跨域 = **88.0 mAP（MaxSim + flip）**。目标 **> 88.0**。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage.md:17371:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:1890:experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:9:exp260b 已有 OA-SD（occluded student ↔ clean EMA teacher 双前向）+ PLBOA（下肢遮挡增广），但其蒸馏只作用在 **pooled global 特征**（cosine）。BT-PKD 进一步蒸馏 per-keypoint 特征**方向**（cosine），仍是「让被遮挡 token 的特征向 clean token 看齐」。两者都没有触碰探针指认的真正病灶：**被遮挡 per-part token 的归一化统计（一阶/二阶矩）整体漂移到一个可分离的子空间**——这是一条「有/无遮挡」的 domain 轴，叠加在身份信号上。OA-SD/BT-PKD 把个体特征拉近，但没有显式消掉这条 domain 轴；探针显示这条轴在跨域时大量残留（pre-GCN AUC 0.97），GCN 只部分修复。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage.md:17372:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:1895:experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:61:   - **复用现成 dual-forward**：exp260b 已是 `parallel_oa_sd`（3 occluded student + 1 clean teacher），teacher 前向已在 OA-SD 段算出 `teacher_kp_data`，**VCA 不新增前向、不增显存峰值的额外 backbone pass**。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage.md:17373:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:1900:experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:93:  - VC-Norm 净增益**只能 vs 这条对照**，**不能 vs 原 exp260b 88.0**（后者 PLBOA=False，是另一条 baseline）。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage.md:17374:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:1901:experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:94:- **PLBOA 说明（重要）**：exp260b 原 config `POSE_LOWER_BODY_OCC=False`，此时 OA-SD 的 teacher≈student（代码已 warning「near-identical images」），OA-SD 近退化。VC-Norm 要 occluded-vs-clean 的对比信号**必须开 PLBOA**，故本实验与对照都设 `POSE_LOWER_BODY_OCC=True`。因此严格单变量对照是「同 PLBOA、VC-Norm 开/关」，**不是** vs 原 exp260b 88.0（后者 PLBOA 关）。88.0 仅作量级参照；若开 PLBOA 的 VC-Norm-OFF 对照已偏离 88.0，以对照为准。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage.md:17375:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:1910:experiments/exp263_best_b_od_s42/claude_review.md:12:H1. Swin-Base + WITH_CP + POSE_PARALLEL_AUG (4 views) + OA-SD on 5060Ti 16G：Base 首 epoch OOM 风险。exp260b 历史 3090 运行 OK，但 5060Ti 16G 需要监控。若 OOM：关 OA-SD 或 PARALLEL_AUG，不改 BS。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage.md:17376:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:1937:experiments/exp267_best_t_m_s42/claude_review.md:12:H1. Swin-Base + WITH_CP + POSE_PARALLEL_AUG (4 views) + OA-SD on 5060Ti 16G：Base 首 epoch OOM 风险。exp260b 历史 3090 运行 OK，但 5060Ti 16G 需要监控。若 OOM：关 OA-SD 或 PARALLEL_AUG，不改 BS。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage.md:17378:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:2078:experiments/exp328_vcnorm/claude_review.md:26:- 单变量对照设计正确：design.md §对照组明确"严格单变量 = 同 PLBOA、VC-Norm 开/关"，并诚实说明**不是** vs 原 exp260b 88.0（原 exp260b PLBOA=False），88.0 仅作量级参照。这一点处理得对（见下方 High-1 的隐患）。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage.md:17379:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:2081:experiments/exp328_vcnorm/claude_review.md:68:- **High-1 [实验设计 / 对照基线]**：yml 与 exp260b baseline 的差异不止 VC-Norm 一项——本 yml `POSE_LOWER_BODY_OCC=True`，而原 exp260b 88.0 是 `POSE_LOWER_BODY_OCC=False` 跑出来的。VC-Norm 需要 PLBOA 提供 occluded-vs-clean 信号，所以开 PLBOA 是必须的，但这意味着 **"88.0"不能直接当对照**。design.md 已经诚实指出这点，但**必须实跑 VC-Norm-OFF + PLBOA-ON 的对照实验**才能算 VC-Norm 净增益，否则结论无效。

experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage.md:17413:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:7019:./experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:5:> **baseline**：exp260b（Swin-Base + 2-stage PSG + LGPA-D + GCN512 + OA-SD + PLBOA），Market 训练 → Occluded-ReID 跨域 = **88.0 mAP（MaxSim + flip）**。目标 **> 88.0**。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage.md:17414:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:7020:./experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:9:exp260b 已有 OA-SD（occluded student ↔ clean EMA teacher 双前向）+ PLBOA（下肢遮挡增广），但其蒸馏只作用在 **pooled global 特征**（cosine）。BT-PKD 进一步蒸馏 per-keypoint 特征**方向**（cosine），仍是「让被遮挡 token 的特征向 clean token 看齐」。两者都没有触碰探针指认的真正病灶：**被遮挡 per-part token 的归一化统计（一阶/二阶矩）整体漂移到一个可分离的子空间**——这是一条「有/无遮挡」的 domain 轴，叠加在身份信号上。OA-SD/BT-PKD 把个体特征拉近，但没有显式消掉这条 domain 轴；探针显示这条轴在跨域时大量残留（pre-GCN AUC 0.97），GCN 只部分修复。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage.md:17415:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:7027:./experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:93:  - VC-Norm 净增益**只能 vs 这条对照**，**不能 vs 原 exp260b 88.0**（后者 PLBOA=False，是另一条 baseline）。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage.md:17416:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:7028:./experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:94:- **PLBOA 说明（重要）**：exp260b 原 config `POSE_LOWER_BODY_OCC=False`，此时 OA-SD 的 teacher≈student（代码已 warning「near-identical images」），OA-SD 近退化。VC-Norm 要 occluded-vs-clean 的对比信号**必须开 PLBOA**，故本实验与对照都设 `POSE_LOWER_BODY_OCC=True`。因此严格单变量对照是「同 PLBOA、VC-Norm 开/关」，**不是** vs 原 exp260b 88.0（后者 PLBOA 关）。88.0 仅作量级参照；若开 PLBOA 的 VC-Norm-OFF 对照已偏离 88.0，以对照为准。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage.md:17417:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:7035:./experiments/exp328_vcnorm/claude_review.md:26:- 单变量对照设计正确：design.md §对照组明确"严格单变量 = 同 PLBOA、VC-Norm 开/关"，并诚实说明**不是** vs 原 exp260b 88.0（原 exp260b PLBOA=False），88.0 仅作量级参照。这一点处理得对（见下方 High-1 的隐患）。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage.md:17418:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:7037:./experiments/exp328_vcnorm/claude_review.md:68:- **High-1 [实验设计 / 对照基线]**：yml 与 exp260b baseline 的差异不止 VC-Norm 一项——本 yml `POSE_LOWER_BODY_OCC=True`，而原 exp260b 88.0 是 `POSE_LOWER_BODY_OCC=False` 跑出来的。VC-Norm 需要 PLBOA 提供 occluded-vs-clean 信号，所以开 PLBOA 是必须的，但这意味着 **"88.0"不能直接当对照**。design.md 已经诚实指出这点，但**必须实跑 VC-Norm-OFF + PLBOA-ON 的对照实验**才能算 VC-Norm 净增益，否则结论无效。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage.md:17421:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:7755:./experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_ovli.txt:3337:experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:5:> **baseline**：exp260b（Swin-Base + 2-stage PSG + LGPA-D + GCN512 + OA-SD + PLBOA），Market 训练 → Occluded-ReID 跨域 = **88.0 mAP（MaxSim + flip）**。目标 **> 88.0**。
